additional_info.subject: RE: ID0397509-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2 / R6 313065117101] Blackscreen issue CRM:01282000745
additional_info.body:
Hello Furkan,
The description is editable, you may add files or photograph as file going ahead.
I
nspect the connections, as there may be a loose connection between KF1 and PH2. Please ensure that the DPP and USB connections used for the OC display and touch functionality are properly checked and kindly check the supply voltage 24v.
Additionally, there is a possibility that the DPP or USB cable may be faulty. We recommend swapping them with working cables to confirm. If the issue persists after these checks, the screen will need to be replaced.
During the site visit, please bring a spare HMI, DPP, and USB cable in case replacements are necessary.
Kindly refer to the marked HMI schematic below and also review the attached Q-feedback for troubleshooting.
https://support.industry.siemens.com/cs/document/109816666/si-e-q-feedback-q2302-sicharge-d-hmi-backlight-off-and-scrambled-image-due-to-router-emissions?dti=0&lc=en-WW
Please note, if the charger's DLogic is Gen2, then Q-feedback process will not apply.
For that we need to check the above connection.
When ordering spare parts, please consider the type of existing control panel to ensure compatibility with the new HMI.
For your reference, kindly review the parts listed below.
If you require any further assistance or clarification, please do not hesitate to reach out to us.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team - Vaishnavy Gurav
